tool_calls.arguments: {"diagnoses": [{"issue_code": "price_mismatch", "line": 1, "cause": "overcharge", "evidence": [{"kind": "purchase_order", "ref": "PO-2026-0052", "detail": "PO line for 'Antivirus License 1 Year' is fixed at unit price 356500 for quantity 5, while the invoice bills 403300 per unit."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-012#2.1", "detail": "Unit prices are set out in Schedule A and remain fixed for the term of the Agreement."}, {"kind": "contract_clause", "ref": "KTR-V-012#11.1", "detail": "The only price change by addendum (Addendum No. 1 dated August 10, 2026, effective September 20, 2026) covers External SSD 1TB, not Antivirus License 1 Year; no contract price exists for the invoiced item."}, {"kind": "invoice", "ref": "OSC26100500", "detail": "Invoice dated 2026-10-10 bills line 1 at 403300 per unit, above the PO price."}], "explanation": "The invoice bills Antivirus License 1 Year at 403300 per unit against a PO price of 356500, and the vendor's contract fixes unit prices with the only addendum price change applying to a different item (External SSD 1TB), so the higher unit price is not allowed."}]}
